title: Surface engineering enables robust SEI growth towards a stable and efficient lithium-ion battery SiOx anode
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1977-1987
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08407E, Paper

Fan Wu, Hongcao Shi, Guijia Hu, Xiangshun Yan, Zihao Wang, Jinhao Shu, Gaoyuan Chen, Yongshu Wang, Jianwei Wang, Yuan Chen
It is challenging to enhance the cycling stability and rate capability of SiOx (0 < x < 2) anodes for commercialization, due to the random and disordered growth of the solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) on the anode surface.
